//: How the First Officer and the other voices say abbreviations. 'words' are said as a word: the right side is a spelling your voice engine reads correctly - change it if a word sounds wrong on your engine (Kokoro, ElevenLabs, Google and Windows do not read the same spelling the same way). 'letters' are said letter by letter (APU = A P U). Only the CAPITAL form of a whole word is changed: STAR is the arrival, star is a star. To leave an abbreviation exactly as written, give it an empty spelling: "SID": "". Your entries are added to the built-in list, so you only need the ones you change. Restart the app after you edit this file.
